intent: A storyteller who starts mid-thought: a huge, hot, empty land with a secret — then the quiz. Dry wit on the reveal, awe on the numbers.
pacing_profile: story hook over a slowly turning globe, three quick options, a 3-s beat, a dry reveal, three see-it beats, CTA and loop
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).

lines.direction: a story, told like a secret
lines.text: A whole kingdom, and not a single river runs through it. Which country?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: Saudi Arabia. Not one permanent river in the entire country.
Water runs only in wadis: dry valleys that flood after rain.
In the Empty Quarter, dunes rise over two hundred metres, and nothing flows.
So the taps run on desalinated sea water, and ancient groundwater.
Got it? Hit like and subscribe for the next map.

title: Which country has NO rivers at all?
